data.title: Anya at Arabian Ranches 3
data.about:
Anya is a beautiful gated community with townhouses that are in close proximity to nature and all of its splendor. 

With lush greenery and beautiful open spaces, as well as a wealth of world-class leisure and recreational activities, Anya is the ideal suburban location for family-oriented living. These wonderfully constructed 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses are ideal for raising a family, providing the ideal blend of elegance, space, and architectural finesse. Anya has wonderful architectural aspects that blend very well with the surrounding natural splendor.

location_tile.title: Find Your Happy Place
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Enjoy a healthy and rewarding existence at Anya, where you are never more than a few feet away from a plethora of world-class amenities and cutting-edge facilities, such as a lush Central Park, clubhouse, cycling routes, walking trails, and much more.
